overlap_report.basis: screening + content verification complete; every unresolved or confirmed external candidate quarantined; internal confirmed groups isolated as identity units
overlap_report.claim: no confirmed or unresolved overlap remains in roles under identity-v1 / verification-v1 thresholds; this is not a proof of zero leakage
limitations: heuristic near-duplicate thresholds cannot prove absence of every reformatting/translation
external images are rendered from official PDFs; original PNG archive not acquired
short generic questions excluded from semantic near-duplicate matching
Not a final independence pass: apply all quarantine and local duplicate components before split validation.
Title matches in first two pages are candidates, not automatic document identity.
Image-only ambiguous candidates are conservatively unresolved.
Local text comparison covers first two pages; separate full-page near-duplicate audit is required.
Thresholds identify observable similarities; they cannot rule out every rewriting or translation.
Groups mean shared page evidence requiring role isolation, not whole-document equivalence.
One shared copyright/frontmatter page is not automatically a confirmed document duplicate.
Sparse text sketches and capped image buckets do not guarantee exhaustive near-duplicate recall.
Low-resolution image similarity alone cannot establish page identity; OCR-poor matches remain unknown.
Common trigrams, visually sparse pages, and repetitive text are suppressed to reduce boilerplate links.
Transitive unknown groups are review/isolation candidates, not certified duplication or a final split.
Identical translations, reformatted pages, OCR failures, and semantic paraphrases can be missed.

policy.external_quarantine: verification decisions unresolved or confirmed; screening-only candidates rejected by content verification are not quarantined
policy.identity_units: internal confirmed_doc_groups (>=2 distinct matching pages each side), merged transitively; atomic in assignment
policy.dev_priority: unit touching old dev keeps dev documents and quarantines old-test members
policy.page_level: internal unknown/confirmed page pairs across roles are excluded per unit by build_route_v2_regions.py, not by quarantining documents
